revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate for achievement_medal_travel_tier_003, later converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one premium collectible travel achievement medal for tier 3, BLUE rank, based on the Chinese title concept "观光达人" (sightseeing expert who mostly takes photos because a rich friend is around). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Input image role: the attached rank-medal screenshot is a reference for progressive border complexity only; do not copy its shield shape, numbers, dark UI, text, or exact design.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. Tier 3 has an ordinary circular medal plus refined decoration: bright sapphire-blue enamel rim, polished silver and small warm-gold bevels, symmetrical side winglets or upward side fins, a small top jewel, and a tiny lower badge shape; clearly more ornate than tier 2 but not as ornate as purple/orange/gold tiers. Inside the circle is one compact funny center object: a cream travel suitcase holding one oversized tourist camera pointed back at itself for a smug selfie. The camera is the only auxiliary object and should be readable; suitcase remains dominant.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, refined and readable at small iOS size, playful but premium, crisp transparent-asset silhouette, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: base circular size consistent with a six-medal set; tier 3 outer decoration moderately larger than tier 2; full medal visible, no cropping; centered symmetrical front view.
Lighting/mood: bright tourist-photo comedy, clean enamel shine, premium blue rank feel.
Color palette: sapphire blue rim, silver and small gold metal, cream suitcase, black and gold camera, glassy camera lens, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: glossy enamel, polished blue-silver metal, glass camera lens, subtle beveled rim, lacquered toy surfaces, clean edges. No paper texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: one medal only; no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no map, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane, no seat, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no shield badge, no black background, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
title: 观光达人
concept: 蓝色精致圆形加对称侧翼，中心为观光自拍旅行箱
integration_note: TripPet 1.0.8 travel medal redesign: six-level white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold rank progression; source PNG copied byte-identically to app-facing @3x PNG.
